---
title: "Examples from the help file"
subtitle: "The examples in help lca_entropy, run in full"
---
<<dd_version: 2>>

The example at the end of `help lca_entropy`: a two-class latent class
model on the Stata Press `gsem_lca1` data (four binary items on risk
taking), followed by the entropy statistic.

```{.stata-run}
<<dd_do>>
use http://www.stata-press.com/data/r15/gsem_lca1, clear
gsem ( -> accident play insurance stock), logit lclass(C 2)
<</dd_do>>
```

```{.stata-run}
<<dd_do>>
lca_entropy
<</dd_do>>
```

The statistic is returned in `r(entropy)`, so it can be collected across
models with different numbers of classes:

```{.stata-run}
<<dd_do>>
display r(entropy)
<</dd_do>>
```
